bpmn2:process.studyflow:documentation: Figure 3(b): the example study's participant flow in Studyflow, grouped into the four CONSORT 2025 phases (enrolment, allocation, follow-up, analysis). Attrition is encoded as boundary error events wired to counted error end events, so the topology of the published CONSORT flow is the topology the runner executes. The phase bands are bpmn:Group artifacts, a projection device that only annotates and never changes the control flow.
bpmn2:process.name: CONSORT participant flow
